tagline.en_US: Immich as a coordinated four-LXC native OCI stack with private PostgreSQL and Valkey services, persistent media and model cache, and selectable hardware acceleration.

description.en_US: Immich is a self-hosted photo and video management solution. It allows users to upload, organize, and view media through web and mobile interfaces with multi-user support. The application features automatic deduplication, shared albums, facial recognition, and metadata search to help manage personal media collections.
